title: Split an output stream into lines
responsibility: Decode UTF-8 chunks and deliver complete lines while bounding the buffered text.

inputs.name: streamLines.options
inputs.type: { onLine: (line: string) => void; maxBytes: number; onOverflow: () => void; }
inputs.description: A required options object with line and overflow callbacks and a byte threshold. Each write checks the UTF-8 byte length of accumulated decoded text against maxBytes before splitting on `\n`; if it exceeds the threshold, the buffer is cleared and onOverflow runs, while incomplete UTF-8 bytes remain with the decoder across chunks.

outputs.name: streamLines
outputs.description: Returns write(chunk) and end() functions: write expects a Buffer, decodes it as UTF-8, emits each complete `\n`-terminated segment (including empty segments), and retains the trailing segment; end flushes the decoder and emits the trailing segment only when non-empty. The byte limit is checked against the entire accumulated decoded buffer after each write and before splitting, so an overflow invokes onOverflow and discards that buffer.
